_comment: Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json). Quote the /Applications/Warp Command Runner.app path as one JSON string because it contains spaces. If Cursor still reports spawn /Applications/Warp ENOENT, it split the path: run helper/install-cursor-wrapper.sh and set command to ~/.local/bin/warp-command-runner (expand YOURUSER). Optional env.WCR_HOME isolates the data folder from ~/.warp-command-runner. Cursor already has a terminal; register this only if you want commands typed into Warp.
